english.note: Use this for the outward airs or self-important manner that someone puts on.
Use this for an affected sense of superiority or airs, as in someone who has airs.

examples.english: They put on such airs out of conceit that they will not even greet the neighbors.
examples.traditional: 佢擺晒架子，見到街坊都唔肯打招呼。

examples.english: They have an air of superiority and never greet anyone.
examples.traditional: 佢份人好有架子，見到人都唔打招呼。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 jau5 gaa3 zi2 gin3 dou2 jan4 dou1 m4 daa2 ziu1 fu1
